At the time of listing, 1409 South Pacific Street is the only single-family home available directly on the sand in Oceanside.  The 1400 block of South Pacific Street is one of Oceanside's most sought-after oceanfront locations. With no homes across the street and only a handful of beachfront residences, the neighborhood offers a quieter, less-traveled setting while remaining just minutes from the harbor, restaurants, shopping, and downtown.  Unlike most Southern California beachfront properties, this residence includes a private sandy beach within the parcel boundaries—an extraordinary ownership feature rarely found along the California coast. The private beach becomes a natural extension of the home, creating an outdoor living experience that few properties can offer.  With eight bedrooms, an optional ninth bedroom or office, four full bathrooms, a powder room, and three levels of living space, the home is designed to accommodate large gatherings, extended family, and guests without sacrificing comfort or privacy.  A portion of the home is currently operated as a successful short-term rental. The current short-term rental permit does not convey with the sale. Main Level  The kitchen, dining area, and great room are all oriented toward the Pacific, allowing the ocean to become the focal point of everyday living. Sliding doors open to an oceanfront deck, creating an effortless transition between indoor and outdoor spaces. This level also includes a guest bedroom, a full bathroom, a powder room, and a laundry room.  Upper Level  The primary suite overlooks the coastline and features a fireplace, private oceanfront deck, and panoramic views of the Pacific. Three additional bedrooms, a flexible office or media room, and a conveniently located laundry closet complete the upper level.  Beach Level  Created for entertaining and relaxed coastal living, the beach level offers three bedrooms, a full bathroom, an efficiency kitchen, a beach bar with sink and wine refrigerator, a fireplace, and a spacious gathering room that opens directly onto the oceanfront deck.  Just beyond the deck, the property's private sandy beach provides a setting unlike virtually any other home in Oceanside. Spend evenings around the fire pit, enjoy the sound of the waves just steps away, or walk down your private stairs for direct access to the public beach and surf.  A thoughtfully designed lock-off configuration between the main and upper levels offers flexibility for extended family, guests, or a variety of living arrangements.  Nearly 400 square feet of oceanfront decking creates multiple outdoor spaces for dining, relaxing, and taking in the ever-changing coastline, while abundant storage throughout the home enhances everyday functionality.  Additional Features  * Seller financing available for qualified buyers * Private sandy beach within the parcel boundaries * Oceanfront decks on multiple levels * Lock-off floor plan * Single-car garage * Carport plus additional off-street parking * Negotiable furnishings * No HOA * No special assessments  Located just minutes from Oceanside's harbor, restaurants, boutique shopping, and coastal attractions, this home combines one of Southern California's most desirable beachfront settings with the convenience of a vibrant coastal community.  Properties like this seldom come to market. Mature landscaping, low-density surroundings, and a convenient North County location add to the appeal of this unique community. With two primary suites, flexible living spaces, golf course outlooks, and an excellent Oceanside location, this home offers a comfortable and inviting opportunity to enjoy life near El Camino Country Club.

results.remarks: Rarely available corner-lot living in Miraval at Rancho Del Oro. Set on one of the few desirable corner parcels with added separation from neighboring homes, 1300 Enchante Way offers a bright, open floor plan with dramatic ceiling height, abundant natural light and a strong sense of space throughout.  From the moment you enter, soaring two-story ceilings create an immediate sense of volume and openness. The entry flows between the dining area and the heart of the home, where the kitchen and living room come together in one expansive, connected space designed for both everyday living and entertaining.  The kitchen has been thoughtfully refreshed with professionally painted cabinetry, while updated LVP flooring extends throughout the main level for a clean, cohesive look. A fireplace anchors the living room and adds warmth to the open gathering space.  Upstairs, the floor plan continues with four generously sized bedrooms and a spacious open flex area featuring a built-in desk - ideal for a home office, homework station, reading area or additional lounge space. The primary suite includes a walk-in closet and ensuite bath with upgraded shower glass, while the upstairs laundry room adds everyday convenience.  Outside, the backyard is designed for easy, low-maintenance enjoyment with artificial turf and a freshly painted stucco wall, creating a comfortable setting for relaxing, dining and entertaining.  A major added benefit is the amount of recent investment and improvement throughout the property. Nearly all of the home’s most meaningful upgrades have been completed since 2020, including professionally painted kitchen cabinetry, new downstairs blinds, updated flooring throughout the main level, new laundry-room flooring, upgraded primary shower glass, FULLY OWNED SOLAR with NEM 2.0! Additional improvements include an EV charger, refreshed backyard stucco and central A/C added in 2018, making many of the home’s most important comfort, efficiency and cosmetic upgrades relatively recent.  Ideally located, the home offers convenient access to nearby parks, schools, shopping, dining, recreation and major commuter routes, plus a community tot lot/playground located within the Miraval tract itself, near the center of the neighborhood and just a short walk from the home, along with the everyday amenities that make this area of Oceanside so desirable.  With its coveted corner-lot setting, dramatic two-story interior volume, open entertaining spaces, recent upgrades and energy-efficient features, this property offers an exceptional combination of space, functionality and value.

results.remarks: Welcome to Ocean Lofts, an exclusive community of modern loft residences just steps from the beach in the heart of Downtown Oceanside! Expansive windows and soaring ceilings create a bright, airy interior, while the flexible floor plan provides endless possibilities to personalize the space for your lifestyle. Ocean Lofts offers the flexibility of live/work zoning while functioning beautifully as a modern coastal residence. On-site amenities include a fitness center, spacious private storage lockers, central A/C, in-unit laundry, and assigned parking. A rare opportunity to own a versatile corner loft where the beach, dining, entertainment, and vibrant Downtown Oceanside lifestyle are right outside your door.

results.remarks: Perched atop one of Oceanside's highest residential streets, this beautifully upgraded single-story home captures refreshing coastal breezes and the effortless indoor-outdoor lifestyle Southern California is known for—all within the highly sought-after Carlsbad Unified School District.  The main home features three bedrooms, complemented by a separate, fully finished bedroom space within the garage, offering exceptional flexibility for guests, work-from-home needs, hobbies, or additional living space. Thoughtfully redesigned and meticulously maintained, this is a home where every improvement has been made with quality, comfort, and everyday living in mind. The heart of the home is the beautifully reimagined open-concept living space, where the wall between the kitchen and living room has been removed to create seamless sight lines and effortless flow for entertaining. Anchoring the space is a stunning oversized island with quartz waterfall countertops, custom cabinetry, a dedicated coffee bar, recessed lighting, and abundant prep and gathering space. Wide-plank flooring and an abundance of natural light enhance the home's bright, airy coastal feel. The spacious primary suite serves as a true retreat with an expanded ensuite bathroom featuring a luxurious rainfall shower and designer finishes.  Step outside and experience the lifestyle this property was designed for. An expansive view deck offers the perfect setting for morning coffee, sunset dinners, or weekend gatherings while taking in the elevated outlook. The terraced backyard provides multiple usable spaces, including a lower level ideal for lawn games, a play area, gardening, or simply relaxing beneath the trees. A finished detached flex space offers endless possibilities as a home office, creative studio, playroom, or hobby retreat, while an additional storage shed adds valuable functionality. A finished bonus room within the garage provides even more versatile space for today's evolving lifestyle (buyer to verify permits and approved use).  Extensive recent improvements include owned solar for exceptionally low electric bills, a new electrical panel (2026), central air conditioning and ducting (2023), new water heater (2025), remodeled bathrooms, new gutters, custom blinds, updated electrical, exterior paint, front fencing, fresh landscaping and irrigation, an outdoor BBQ area, and countless additional thoughtful upgrades. Every detail has been carefully considered so the next owner can simply move in and enjoy.  Perfectly positioned just minutes from Lake Calavera Preserve, Calavera Hills Community Park, shopping, dining, and convenient access to both Highway 78 and Interstate 5, you'll also enjoy being approximately five miles from the beach and just ten minutes from the boutiques, breweries, and Michelin-recognized restaurants of Carlsbad Village. This exceptional home offers the perfect balance of modern comfort, coastal charm, and one of North County's most convenient locations.

results.remarks: Experience coastal living at its finest in this beautifully remodeled beach condo, perfectly positioned in the highly sought-after North Coast Village. Enjoy whitewater ocean views from both balconies, with the expansive upper balcony offering the perfect retreat to watch sailboats drift by and catch glimpses of sea life. Spanning the 3rd and 4th floors of the desirable C building, this residence features a living area with a tiled fireplace and tasteful furnishings, including a queen sofa bed and 2 recliners. The kitchen offers sleek countertops, recessed lighting, stone-look flooring, and refreshed cabinets. North Coast Village offers an unbeatable resort-style lifestyle, complete with two heated pools and spas, putting green, ocean-view BBQ area, and lush tropical landscaping throughout. Stay active in the fully equipped gym, unwind in the saunas, and enjoy the peace of mind that comes with 24-hour gated and guarded security. Reserved garage parking is also included. This home is being sold mostly furnished, making it a true turnkey opportunity to embrace the beach lifestyle.  As you walk through the staffed secure gate to North Coast Village you are transported to a tropical oasis reminiscent of the Costa Rican Rain Forest. Running streams, waterfalls, lush foliage, and Koi make their way through the spacious grounds of this resort-like beachfront condominium complex in Oceanside California. You will notice the crystal clear heated pool and spa, gleaming barbecues, convenient picnic tables, sand rinsing stations to remove the lingering beach. If you need a break from sun and surf, you might enjoy a game of pool on one of North Coast Village's 2 new pool tables, a jog on a treadmill in the exercise room, a little ping pong, or a sauna. Feeding our giant Koi is a simple pleasure not to be missed during your Oceanside visit. When you venture all the way through the back gates, you find yourself on one of North San Diego County’s finest beaches: broad and flat, with volleyball and great surf breaks - right out back! To your right, you can walk or bike to Oceanside’s busy little harbor for a bite to eat or some boating, and to your left you can venture down the strand to southern California’s longest pier for some fishing (no license needed).  North Coast Village is close enough to walk to everything near the beach, so your car can stay in its secure underground parking spot - especially useful when beach parking becomes a premium in the summer. The Mainstreet Oceanside Farmer's Market is a delightful experience near the Pier which takes place every Thursday from 9-1, and and the Sunset Market Thursday evenings from 5-9. Check out the many new restaurants, shops, and hotels in downtown Oceanside!

results.remarks: Every gated community has a handful of homes that people quietly hope will come up. In St. Cloud, it's the end units the ones with a private entrance of their own, only a single shared wall, and windows on three sides. This is one of them, and it is every bit as bright as you're imagining. Built in 2019, this three-level townhome offers approximately 1,702 square feet, 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms. High ceilings and designer finishes set the tone the moment you step inside, and custom plantation shutters on every window let you decide exactly how much of that Southern California sun to invite in full and golden in the morning, filtered and soft in the afternoon. The main level is one connected, open space: a kitchen finished with quartz countertops, a full backsplash, stainless steel appliances, crisp cabinetry and an island with seating, opening directly to the dining and living areas. Weeknight dinners are easy here. So is a house full of people. Warm wood laminate flooring runs throughout the level, with a powder room tucked away for guests. The main-level bedroom with its own en-suite bath is the detail buyers remember. Visiting family, a live in parent, a roommate, or a genuinely private home office it solves a problem most townhomes don't. Upstairs, the primary suite is a retreat: walk-in closet, dual vanities, room to exhale. A secondary bedroom, full bath and upper-level laundry complete the floor, with plush carpet underfoot throughout the bedroom level. Downstairs, the oversized two-car attached garage has been finished with durable epoxy flooring and opens directly into the home. St. Cloud is one of the strongest amenity packages in Rancho Del Oro, and it shows: a junior Olympic swimming pool and spa with a newly resurfaced deck, shaded cabanas, a clubhouse with kitchenette you can reserve for private gatherings, a fitness center, BBQ and picnic areas, a basketball court, playgrounds, and wide green lawns for the kind of afternoon that doesn't need a plan. Grounds are professionally maintained, guest parking is plentiful, and the whole community sits behind controlled-access gates. Martin Luther King Jr. Park is right across the way skate park, baseball and soccer fields, and a tot lot. Ivey Ranch Elementary and Martin Luther King Jr. Middle School are an easy walk, with El Camino High nearby. Ocean Ranch and Frontier shopping, grocery, restaurants, gyms, coffee and golf are all minutes out, public transportation is close, and Highways 76 and 78 plus I-5 put Carlsbad, Vista, San Marcos and Camp Pendleton within a short drive. Point the car west and you're at Oceanside Harbor, the pier, the Thursday farmers market and open beach in about ten minutes. First-time buyers who refuse to compromise on location. Investors who understand what gated, amenity-rich and walkable does for demand. And anyone downsizing who wants less maintenance without giving up a single square foot of lifestyle. FHA and VA approved, turnkey, and ready right now. Stylish, secure, and perfectly located, this is the Southern California coastal lifestyle without the coastal-maintenance headache. Schedule your private showing today, because the end units in St. Cloud hardly come around.
